verdict.rationale: Vapi documents Composer, a built-in assistant where you 'describe what you want to build and Composer handles the technical setup,' which is direct in-product task delegation. The evidence is only one thin line, though. The MCP server and IDE-assistant integrations are external AI clients, not built-in assistants, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: detailed Composer docs on which tasks it can perform and how far its actions reach, review or approval of its changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: describe what you want to build and Composer handles the technical setup
